scripts.build: npm -w @cifedra/core run build && npm -w @cifedra/postgres run build && npm -w @cifedra/api run build && npm -w @cifedra/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w @cifedra/core run typecheck && npm -w @cifedra/core run build && npm -w @cifedra/postgres run typecheck && npm -w @cifedra/postgres run build && npm -w @cifedra/api run typecheck && npm -w @cifedra/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm -w @cifedra/core run test && npm -w @cifedra/core run build && npm -w @cifedra/postgres run test && npm -w @cifedra/postgres run build && npm -w @cifedra/api run test
scripts.local:restart: npm run local:stop && npm run local:start
